html:
Bob Denard was a French mercenary who fought in many African wars and took part in four coups in the Comoros between 1975 and 1995, running the islands for years from behind the scenes.

After fighting in Congo and elsewhere, he helped overthrow the first president of the independent Comoros in 1975, and in 1978 brought Ahmed Abdallah back to power. For eleven years he commanded the presidential guard, owned businesses and converted to Islam.

In 1989 Abdallah was shot dead in disputed circumstances, and France and South Africa forced Denard out. He returned in a coup in 1995 but was removed by French troops. The many coups left the islands unstable and fed the secession of Anjouan.
sum: Bob Denard was a French mercenary who fought in many African wars and took part in four coups in the Comoros between 1975 and 1995, running the islands for years from behind the scenes.
